---
title: "Specimens Processed"
format: html
---

```{r}
ThawCounts <- list.files(pattern="ThawCounts.csv", recursive=TRUE)
```

```{r}
CSV_Extract <- function(x){
    Data <- utils::read.csv(x, check.names=FALSE)
    Experiment <- basename(x)
    Experiment <- gsub("_ThawCounts.csv", "", Experiment)
    Data <- Data |> dplyr::mutate(Experiment=Experiment)
    return(Data)
}
```

```{r}
Data <- purrr::map(.f=CSV_Extract, .x=ThawCounts) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

Data |> dplyr::arrange(bid) |> dplyr::pull(bid) |> unique()
```
